presets.name: Noct Q V4 (Uncensored)
presets.tagline: Qwen Image 2.1 without the censorship, no LoRA needed
presets.description: Noct Q V4, Noctaluna's uncensored build of Qwen-Image 2.1 (INT8). Nudes and explicit scenes render as written, and it keeps Qwen's long-prompt following. Write the prompt as a caption of the finished picture in full sentences: the kind of shot, the person with an adult age ("a woman in her twenties"), what they do, where, the light and the framing. No trigger word. 25 steps at CFG 3 is the author's setting, about 50 s a picture on a 12 GB card; CFG 1 is about twice as fast and then ignores the negative prompt. Sizes are about 1.5 megapixels; 2:3 (1024x1536) is the author's recommended shape.

requirements.notes: LICENCE: Qwen Research License, non-commercial use only; Noct Q is a derivative of Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 with modified transformer weights (see the repo's LICENSE and NOTICE). Model (diffusion_models): Noctaluna/Noct-Q-Uncensored-Qwen-Image-2.1 @ a81b9af5, NoctQ_V4_int8_convrot.safetensors, 7,256,784,368 B, SHA256 4d92d5538253ab36e6a73b056cce5f697950f4303cb9e6686a3198d0ea13f9e8 (the same file as Civitai model 2958896, version 3372040 'V4.0 Base', file 3260131). Text encoder (9.4 GB) and VAE (0.7 GB) are the Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1 files the Qwen Image 2.1 pack uses. Graph: the author's V4 workflow, core nodes only: TextEncodeQwenImage21 (resolution 1024), euler / simple, 25 steps, CFG 3, with the author's negative prompt built in and the user's appended. No APG or FreSca (those belong to the Qwen Image 2.1 pack's own recipe and were not tested on this model). Sizes are about 1.5 MP in multiples of 32; the author gives 1024x1536 as the recommended shape and 2048 px as the native ceiling. Verified in the app 2026-10-12 (SimpliGen 1.73.2, engine 0.38.0, hand-installed copy, 4070 Ti 12 GB): the app downloaded the model itself (sha256 matched); 3 renders at 1024x1536, 1120x1472 and 1696x960 each executed in 49-51 s (about 35 s of sampling at 1.4 s/step), with checkpoint, size, seed, steps, CFG, sampler and the built-in negative read back from the engine. A clothed prompt, one of the author's nude example prompts and a three-word sign all rendered as written, one seed each. Output is RGBA, like the other Qwen 2.1 cards. LoRAs, CFG 1 and editing not tested.
